name: skill-tree
description: Per-project skill provisioning + global cluster fallback. AI-categorizer picks the right skills for each project.

interface.longDescription: Pick the right skills for each project automatically. Solves the 'iPhone skills in a JavaScript project' problem by provisioning ~5 relevant skills into <project>/.claude/skills/ instead of leaving the full global catalog in every prelude.
defaultPrompt: What skills does this project actually need?
